approval_gates.prompt: Review the deepened lineage-hit sealed by m2-deepen against the original pass's hits and the reused internal-inventory. Approve to spend the reweave: on your yes, m3-reweave re-draws the lineage-map from the reused internal-inventory plus both the original and deepened external hits, judges the gap, and composes a fresh lineage-record. Nothing is re-woven on an absent yes.
